basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled 3BD/3BA two-story home with modern finishes and excellent indoor-outdoor flow. The main level features a bright open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area with 9-ft ceilings, new engineered hardwood floors, and built-in media cabinetry. The kitchen is fully equipped with brand-new Bosch stainless appliances. Stylish light fixtures and dual rows of recessed lighting keep the home bright day or night.  A large sliding glass door opens to a spacious wooden deck with sweeping views and stairs leading to a landscaped backyard. Upstairs offers two bedrooms, including a primary suite with custom closet organizers and an en-suite bath.  Entry level includes a wide foyer, fully renovated garage, family room with sliding door access to the garden, a bedroom with garden views, and a full bath. The serene backyard features low-maintenance tropical landscaping and a grand redwood tree.  Prime location: half-block to Muni on Ocean Ave. and walking distance to the Balboa Park BART station; minutes to I-280, City College, and all the shops and cafes along Ocean Avenue.  Don't miss this fantastic home.
